title: Heidelberg Register of Chronic Singultus
summary: Chronic hiccups is a rare disease with a very high level of suffering for those affected. Treatment is based on individual case reports or case series. The aim of this study is to establish a registry for patients with chronic hiccups. In a first step, existing data from patients will be retrospectively entered into a standard mask and analysed. In a second step, all patient contacts at the Centre for Chronic Singultus will be entered into a standard mask. This will enable longitudinal observation of the patients. Ultimately, it should be possible to categorise the severity of the disease. The effectiveness of the therapy should be reviewed on an evidence-based basis over time. Overuse, underuse or misuse should be avoided.

interventions.name:
Patients (all age groups) with chronic singultus (> 3 months) who have been or will be admitted to the Centre for Chronic Singultus at the University Hospital of Heidelberg will be included in the registry following consensus.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients with chronic singultus who are able to give consent and are affiliated with the Centre for Chronic Singultus at Heidelberg University Hospital, all age groups. This includes both patients presenting for the first time and patients presenting to the centre again.
Exclusion criteria:
Refusal to participate in the study by the patient or, in the case of minors, also by the parents, lack of consent, insufficient understanding of the German language by the patient or, in the case of minors, by the parents.
